text:
lena: quick heads-up: I'm landing the changelog draft for Monday. Need a small snippet/migration sweep for embeddings and a couple link fixes.
sam: which files?
lena: check guides/embeddings.md, sdk/python/embeddings.md, sdk/js/embeddings.md, and the migration note embed-streaming.md. Also update changelog/2026-03 to include a short code diff so devs can scan the change quickly.
igor: I'll run a linkcheck over the guides and replace any absolute marketplace URLs with docs.redwood.ai canonical links. Found a vendor marketplace link earlier that 404s.
sam: I'll rewrite the snippets to show the non-streaming pattern and a tiny helper wrapper for convenience. Will add BEFORE/AFTER so it's obvious.
lena: please also call out the token-behavior change when moving off streaming; mention that batching may offset the extra tokens in many workloads and link to Optimize batching guide.
sam: drafting now. planning to open PR with tests. code samples I intend to add: 
```py
# BEFORE (streaming style)
resp = client.embeddings.stream_create(model='embed-001', input=text)
for chunk in resp:
    handle(chunk)

# AFTER (non-streaming + helper)
def embed_sync(client, model, input):
    return client.embeddings.create(model=model, input=input)

vec = embed_sync(client, 'embed-001', text)
```
```js
// BEFORE
for await (const part of client.embeddings.streamCreate({ model: 'embed-001', input })) {
  process(part)
}
// AFTER
async function embedSync(client, model, input) {
  return await client.embeddings.create({ model, input, stream: false })
}
const v = await embedSync(client, 'embed-001', input)
```
igor: added a short note on token accounting in the migration doc and linked to /docs/optimize/batching.md. Also fixed three broken anchors in guides/embeddings.md.
docs-bot: New PR created: #5483 by sam - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5483
lena: one more: add a Known Issues bullet in the relnotes: "Dedicated customers: routing fallback to beta variants has triggered intermittent 503s under heavy load; to avoid, pin to a stable model or contact support for a private rollout."
zendesk: FYI — we've got two open tickets referencing 503s on Dedicated during fallback, so that note will help triage.
sam: CI running. I added small unit tests that exercise the helper wrapper in both js/python snippets.
igor: rolled link fixes to the branch.
lena: great. if CI passes I'll merge and ship the changelog. tag thread resolved after merge.
sam: :thumbsup: watching CI and will patch quickly if snippets flake.
lena: thanks all. small follow-up after merge: let's add a short FAQ blurb in the migration doc about metric differences (latency vs token-cost) when switching off streaming.
igor: noted, I'll add it in a follow-up commit.
lena: closing here once merged.
